title: Real-Time Synchronization
text: Synchronize model execution to real time in Connected IO mode, 1 output; {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed and {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’
